$comment: A fixture for packages/vn-test/specs/reload.spec.ts: the devtools are OFF at boot (`"devtools": false`, read at the top level) and src/main.ts turns them on with `appDevtools.enable()` once the runtime has run. That is the late order, in which the Network tee goes on over the runtime's realm proxy for WebSocket instead of under it (crates/vn-app/src/devtools/net.rs, "Across a reload"). The listener binds at that call, so vn-test finds the handshake then.
name: devtools-late
